about: A third synthetic person, held out (spec 050): told over ten sessions with a realistic density of messages, then a fresh session with no hints. Frozen on 2026-10-19, after the second round's fixes and before any answer on it was seen. Nothing here is a real person.

messages: Hi, I'm Kofi. I'm 41 and I work as a structural engineer for a bridge company in Leeds.
I'm married to Ama, she's a primary school headteacher.
We have a daughter, Efua, she's 9 and mad about football.
Can you explain the difference between a cable-stayed and a suspension bridge in simple words?
I play the cello in an amateur orchestra, rehearsals are on Monday nights.
Our spring concert is on April 18 and we're doing Dvořák's Eighth.
Any tips for practising fast passages without tensing up?
Thanks, very useful.
Please keep your answers short, a few lines at most, unless I ask for detail.
And I'm lactose intolerant, so no dairy in anything you suggest.
What's a quick lunch I can take to the office?
Nice.
I promised Efua's coach, Mr Haddad, that I'd drive the team to the away match on February 21.
Also I have to renew my chartered engineer membership before March 31.
How do I keep six kids calm in a minibus for an hour?
Ha, good ideas.
Correction: Efua is 10, not 9, her birthday was last week.
My brother Kwame is visiting from Accra in May.
What are fun things to do with a visitor in Leeds?
I drove the team on Saturday, they won 3-1, so that's done.
We're considering getting a dog, but nothing decided yet.
Which breeds are good with kids and fine in a small garden?
Ok, I'll talk with Ama.
Big news: I've been offered a promotion to lead engineer, starting in June.
It means I'll be working from the Manchester office three days a week.
We're staying in Leeds though, I'll take the train.
Can you help me draft a thank-you note to my manager, Helen?
From now on, when you give me times or dates, use the 24-hour clock please, I mix up am and pm.
Renewed my chartered membership yesterday.
The orchestra moved rehearsals to Tuesday nights because the hall changed.
Any tips for a long train commute to make it productive?
I told Ama I'd book the summer holiday cottage in Wales by the end of April.
I also need to buy a new cello case before the concert, mine has a broken zip.
What should I look for in a cello case?
Thanks.
We decided against the dog for now, maybe next year.
The concert went great on Saturday, I used my new case.
Efua's team made it to the regional final.
Can you suggest a light stretching routine after a long day of sitting?
